claim: The ATC rate tolerance does not matter
test: Fixed ATC rates across 74.5 to 75.5 deg/s (0.025 deg/s step), time series vs exact CDF, worst three modes
criterion: No rate where clock and exact CDFs differ by more than 1 dB at 99.9%
key_result: 41 rates x 3 modes x 2 trials of 3600 s. Largest |deviation| at 99.9%: 0.41 dB (VCP 212 SAILSx3 AVSET 6.4, 75.300 deg/s); 0 runs over 1 dB.
